notes.per_1k_queries_usd: Measured request/compute cost during the benches (DynamoDB: billed search bytes; S3 Vectors: request + processed + returned; Aurora/OpenSearch: measured ACU-h/OCU-h during the bench window divided by 9,000 queries). Sequential single client.
notes.at_rest_month_usd: Storage only, list price, before any free tier (DynamoDB has 25 GB-month free). Sizes: DynamoDB TableSizeBytes, S3 Vectors estimated n*(1024*4+64) B, OpenSearch StorageUsedInHot, Aurora pg_total_relation_size of the chunks table.

always_awake_floor_month_usd.basis: Aurora/OpenSearch bill capacity-hours while awake and only scale to zero after ~10 idle minutes; measured ~0.67 ACU and ~1.0 SearchOCU while serving. Traffic every few minutes keeps them awake all month (730 h).

notes.cold_start: First query after ~16 min idle: OpenSearch 23.2 s, Aurora 12.5 s resume + ~1.3 s, DynamoDB 77 ms, S3 Vectors 89 ms (results/2026-10-09/cold-start.json).
